hook.text: Izanagi followed his dead wife Izanami to the underworld. She begged him not to look at her.

buildup.text: He lit a torch and saw her: rotting, crawling with maggots, furious at being seen in decay.

discovery.text: Izanami chased him in rage. He sealed the entrance with a boulder. Death and life were permanently split.

twist.text: She vowed to kill a thousand people daily. He vowed to create fifteen hundred. Life and death raced.

climax.text: Japanese death myth links shame and sight. Looking at what should stay hidden breaks the world apart.

punchline.text: He looked. She raged. Death began.

quiz.question: What happened when Izanagi looked at his dead wife?
options: She became furious and chased him
